rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst/full blastocyst and appropriately defers to the lab grade, but it adds limited image-specific detail and includes some speculative statements about Day 4/AA appearance without clear visual support.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, semen parameters, lifestyle, and first-cycle status into prognosis and transfer counseling.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, with a coherent link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include some uncertainty around Day 4 grading interpretation and slightly overextended lifestyle inferences.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF best practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unproven add-ons; minor deviations include overconfident implantation/live birth framing and some nonessential ancillary suggestions.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for failure, including SET, luteal support adherence, lifestyle modification, uterine evaluation, and selective future testing.
